Poppy’s Prize

Poppy’s Prize is a two-to-four player poker-style card game in PF2e Tavern Games. Its 54-card deck has 52 suited cards plus two Pirates. The GM chooses Poppy, the ante, and optional currency transfer, then Poppy deals the prepared game.

Common cards and betting

Each participant secretly contributes a hand card to the common pool. The common cards are revealed clockwise from Poppy, with a betting round after each reveal. A bettor may pass when no bet exists, otherwise call, raise, fold, or open a new bet. The module validates each action and any specified minimum.

Pirates and Plunder

After the fourth common-card betting round, each Pirate holder acts. A holder can demand a card from another participant by suit, value, or both. The target surrenders a matching hand card if able. A Pirate holder cannot be a Plunder target.

Showdown and carry-over

After final betting, active participants make the best five-card poker hand from their private hand and the common pool. The pot is paid to the winner or split among ties. Participants may then keep one card for the next game; a winner may instead keep one common card.

Cheating

Any Poppy may cheat by choosing every card needed to complete their hand and selecting either a blind Performance check or a blind Deception check using Create a Diversion. That result is compared privately with each observer’s Perception DC. Observers and the GM receive a whisper only when the cheating result fails or critically fails against that observer. Only a deck owner with an item slugged marked-playing-cards may use the additional marked-card options: on the first game, choose exactly two opening cards; on a later game, elect marked-card sight.

Source acknowledgement. Poppy’s Prize originates in Jewel of the Indigo Isles. This module provides an automation aid and reference; the original adventure remains the source for the game.
